implementation_constraints: reads exactly one JSON value from stdin
prints exactly one line to stdout
exits 0 for both successful and malformed input paths

unresolved_intent.decision: Reject job objects with fields outside id, priority, arrival, duration, and optional deadline.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The contract says each job object has exactly those fields, while the error list does not spell out extra fields; enforcing the contract is the narrower interpretation.

unresolved_intent.decision: Allow negative deadline values as long as deadline is an integer and not a JSON boolean.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The error rules explicitly reject negative arrival and duration only, so adding a negative-deadline validation would create an unstated malformed-input case.

unresolved_intent.decision: Apply deadline checks after same-tick arrivals and before zero-duration starts, so a zero-duration job arriving at or after its deadline is missed rather than started.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The simulation order is binding: arrivals happen first, then deadline checks remove expired ready jobs before selection and execution.

unresolved_intent.decision: Emit idle only when there are no ready jobs and at least one valid job has an arrival tick in the future.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The spec says no idle event is emitted once no job is ready and no job is still to arrive, so idle ticks are bounded by future arrivals.
